task_completion.description: The GUI is set to Playback mode with the correct file loaded.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The control panel or title bar should indicate 'PLAYBACK' mode and the file 'OpenBCI-EEG-S001-EyesOpen.txt' should be selected in the file path field.

task_completion.description: The playback session has been started and is active.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Start Playback' button has been pressed (often turns into a 'Stop' button) and the system clock/timer is incrementing.

task_completion.description: The GUI is configured to a 2-panel layout.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The main dashboard area is divided into exactly two distinct widget containers/panels.

task_completion.description: The Time Series widget is visible and displaying scrolling data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: One panel contains the 'Time Series' widget with active EEG waveforms moving across the screen.

task_completion.description: The Spectrogram widget is visible and displaying scrolling data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The second panel contains the 'Spectrogram' widget showing frequency intensity over time.

task_completion.description: The Spectrogram widget is specifically configured to display Channel 2.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Spectrogram widget settings or header should explicitly show 'Channel 2' or 'Ch 2' as the selected source.

integrity.description: The agent used the OpenBCI GUI interface rather than just terminal commands to manipulate the state.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with GUI buttons, dropdowns, and widget selectors.

integrity.description: The data shown in the widgets is dynamic and corresponds to the playback file, not a static image or placeholder.
integrity.visual_evidence: Waveforms in the Time Series and heatmaps in the Spectrogram show progression/changes across different timestamps in the trajectory.

integrity.description: The agent navigated the widget selection menus to set the layout.
integrity.visual_evidence: Intermediate screenshots show the widget selection dropdown menus being used to select 'Time Series' and 'Spectrogram'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The playback file must be 'OpenBCI-EEG-S001-EyesOpen.txt'. The layout must consist of exactly two panels. One panel must be the 'Time Series' widget and the other must be the 'Spectrogram' widget. Crucially, the Spectrogram must be set to 'Channel 2'. Both widgets must show active, scrolling data indicating the session is running.
